Initial release of Trading Universe — your all-in-one trading analysis tool.

- Three distinct modes: TECHNICAL (ICT intraday setups), FUNDAMENTALS (macro/news-based bias), DASHBOARD (browser-based visualization)
- TECHNICAL mode features instant order tickets for high-probability setups, per-timeframe structure, and watchlist scan; all data from local script, never web search.
- FUNDAMENTALS mode delivers clear bullish/bearish verdicts from macro data and news sentiment via web search.
- Dashboard mode provides a visual overview of signals, structure, and fundamentals in your browser.
- Strict workflow and card output for each mode; never places orders or gives position sizing advice.
- Supported assets include major FX pairs, metals, and key indices.
